scope: confirmed audio evidence gate and linked document figure metadata -> hybrid retrieval -> cited evidence panel

design_basis.adopted_boundary: A# is reserved for explicitly confirmed speech/transcripts; multimodal evidence must remain traceable and must not weaken the document evidence gate.
Preserve document structure and multimodal asset context for hybrid retrieval instead of relying on a bare vector-only chunk.
Link text, tables, and figures as separate evidence types; do not claim image-only or joint-embedding quality without a matched evaluation.

implemented: Only audio events with explicit=true can become A# evidence; confidence alone cannot authorize an ASR transcript.
The browser flow now shows the local transcript and requires confirmation before submitting a recording; the confirmed chat event is marked explicit for the server-side gate.

PDF figure metadata is attached once to the first non-empty page parent with a deterministic figure asset ID, page number, caption, source locator, and vision status; image placeholders remain out of page text.

Figure captions enter the bounded retrieval context as [VISUAL_ASSETS], and visual-asset questions receive a deterministic structure preference without introducing a new model or embedding dependency.
E# citations expose linked visual assets and locators, claim-support checks include their captions, and the evidence panel displays the association and pending-vision status.

targeted_backend.command: pytest -q tests/test_document_parser.py tests/test_knowledge_base_paths.py tests/test_retrieval.py tests/test_answer_quality.py tests/test_interaction_context.py tests/test_rag_prompting.py

regressions: An unconfirmed audio transcript produces no citable A# evidence and is rejected by the audio evidence gate.
A confirmed audio transcript remains citable as A1 and existing meeting-action prompt tests pass.
A PDF figure caption is preserved with page/locator metadata without changing the page chunk into an image-only content kind.
A visual-asset query exposes the linked caption in E# evidence and receives the visual structure preference.
claims_not_supported: No real cross-application episode accuracy, multimodal-vs-text-only gain, or complete-chain P50/P95 claim is made.
No direct image embedding, VLM figure understanding, or chart-value extraction was added; pending_local_model remains explicit.
The encrypted production workspace was not rebuilt or modified without its unlock key.
Unit tests and metadata linkage do not replace the roadmap's frozen 30-episode and sealed-test evaluation gates.
